moments.title: Commonwealth Games in Glasgow
moments.blurb: The 2026 Commonwealth Games are underway in Glasgow, featuring 3,000 athletes from 74 nations competing across various sports until August 2nd.

angles.name: General UK angle

angles.name: Scotland specific angle
angles.copy: Glasgow is buzzing! The Commonwealth Games are here, bringing incredible sporting action to our doorstep until August 2nd. What events are you watching?
